item.title: Thanks to Lake Ontario, MapQuest is popular all over again
UEFA's Champions League draw creates unfair clusters; a Cayley graph fixes it
item.description:
📝 In 2024-25, UEFA scrapped that. Hidden clusters Here’s the thing about 36 teams each playing 8 opponents: it produces a huge network of 144 matches, and inside that network you can find small clusters of teams that happen to play each other disproportionately often. Nine of those matches are internal (both teams from the cluster), and each internal match uses up.
🔗 Read more: https://sariyuce.com/blog/2026/UEFA-Draw/

item.title: Keenable SELECT：在 SQL 中搜索网络的代理
item.description:
📝 Every report in this gallery comes from two agents: a research agent that uses the MCP server to gather the data, and a report agent that runs inside generate_html_report on the server and writes the page. The research agent is a plain tool loop: an LLM with the select tool. A second agent writes each report on the server.
🔤 Original: Keenable SELECT: an agent that searches the web in SQL
🔗 Read more: https://keenableai.github.io/select-showcase/
